speaker: NARRATOR
text: The Last Ferry.

speaker: NARRATOR
heading: INT. HARBOR OFFICE - NIGHT
text: Harbor Office. Night.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A cramped office above the pier. Rain on the window. A wall clock reads 11:52.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mira (30s, the harbor master's deputy, sleeves rolled) stamps a ledger shut and reaches for the light switch.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The door bangs open. Kofi (50s, ferry captain, soaked oilskins) fills the frame.

speaker: KOFI
text: Don't turn that off.

speaker: MIRA
text: Last boat left at eleven. You were on it.

speaker: KOFI
text: ... I turned her around.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: He drops a child's red mitten on the desk. It is still wet.

speaker: MIRA
text: Where did you find that?

speaker: KOFI
text: Floating. Two hundred yards off the point.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A phone on the wall starts to ring. Neither of them moves.

speaker: RADIO VOICE
text: Harbor office, this is Pier Nine. We have a boy here asking for his mother.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mira looks at the mitten. Then at the clock. 11:53.

speaker: NARRATOR
heading: EXT. PIER NINE - NIGHT
text: Pier Nine. Night.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Rain in the floodlights. A small boy, Teo (6), sits on a bollard wrapped in a blanket far too big for him. He holds one red mitten.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mira runs the length of the pier. Kofi follows, slower.

speaker: TEO
text: Did you find the other one?

speaker: MIRA
text: We did.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She presses the wet mitten into his hand. He puts both on, solemnly, and holds them up to the light.

speaker: TEO
text: Now we can go.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Kofi laughs, once, like something breaking loose.

speaker: KOFI
text: Last ferry. All aboard.
